name: You
text: How did you get here so fast!?

name: Wise Crow
text: How did you get here so slow?

name: Wise Crow
text: Press (X) to dash in the current direction you're facing in!

name: Wise Crow
text: Try holding (Z) while dashing as well

name: You
text: What? You didn't answer my question!

name: You
text: How did you get here so fast? How can I get as fast as you?

name: Wise Crow
text: Normally when you dash you get pretty tired so you can usually only do it ONCE in the air

name: Wise Crow
text: But if you rest your wings while on the wall, you can dash again (or just being on the floor)

name: Wise Crow
text: Please be careful, you're my favorite apprenctice yet.
